experiment.hypothesis: Trend posts beat non-trend posts of the same format

_comment: Copy this file to config/watchlist.json (gitignored). Replace the placeholders with handles you track, without @. Set timezone to your IANA zone (America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo, ...). UTC is only the neutral starter. Optional object form also works: {"handle": "example_account", "notes": "why you watch them"}. trend_input_only = accounts (for example a big aggregator) whose posts are fetched and used ONLY as trend signals: never shown as hits, outsiders, leaderboard rows or drafts. lang = en (default) or ru for verdict labels and the ping. experiment = optional trend vs non-trend tracker of YOUR own posts (fill handle + numeric user_id, set enabled true). x_keywords.core = about 16 niche keywords for the X keyword table (24h vs previous 24h, sampled search). Niche starter lists: config/examples/ and docs/WATCHLIST.md.
